comment: handheld, not generated: the sprite is drawn corner to corner like a pickaxe, so the tool grip is the transform it was painted for. The display block below is item/handheld's with 180 added to every Z rotation, which spins the sprite in its own plane about the model centre and so puts the OTHER end in the hand. Without it the player grips the detector by its head instead of its handle. Replace with a real elements model when the art exists, and re-check this then, because a 3D model can simply be built the right way round.
